celebration.name_latin: Sancta Familia Iesu, Mariae et Ioseph

summary_en: The Holy Family of Jesus, Mary and Joseph is confirmed as principal patron of the territorial prelature of Chulucanas (Peru).

summary_en: In Slovakia (then part of Czechoslovakia), besides the holy days of obligation of Epiphany, Ascension and Corpus Christi, the solemnity of All Saints and one solemnity of the Blessed Virgin Mary may also be transferred to the following Sunday.
excerpt: Slovachia, 30 oct. 1974 (Prot. n. 2211/74): conceditur in Slovachia praeter sollemnitates « de praecepto » Epiphaniae, Ascensionis, SS.mi Corporis et Sanguinis Christi (« Normae universales de Anno liturgico et de Calendario » n. 7), transferri etiam possint in dominicam proxime sequentem, sollemnitas Omnium Sanctorum necnon una e sollemnitatibus Beatae Mariae Virginis.

summary_en: In the diocese of Subotica, churches dedicated to the Visitation or to the Holy Name of Mary, and places where the B.V.M. is principal patroness under those titles, may keep those celebrations on 2 July (Visitation) and 12 September (Holy Name of Mary).
excerpt: Suboticana, 11 nov. 1974 (Prot. n. 2304/74): conceditur, ad normam « Instructionis de Calendariis particularibus atque Officiorum et Missarum Propriis recognoscendis », n. 23 b, ut, de iudicio Ordinarii loci, in ecclesiis Deo dicatis in honorem B. Mariae V. sub titulo « Visitationis B. Mariae V. » vel « SS. Nominis Mariae » necnon in locis ubi B. Maria V. sub iisdem titulis tamquam Patrona principalis veneratur, eaedem celebrationes die 2 iulii (« In Visitatione B. Mariae V. ») et die 12 septembris (« De SS. Nomine Mariae ») quotannis peragi valeant.

summary_en: In all churches of the American-Cassinese Benedictine Congregation the celebration of St Benedict may be kept each year on 21 March with the rank of solemnity.
excerpt: Congregatio Americana Casinensis, O.S.B., 29 aug. 1974 (Prot. n. 1966/74): conceditur ut celebratio S. Patris Benedicti, in omnibus ecclesiis Congregationis, quotannis die 21 martii gradu Sollemnitatis peragi valeat.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Tortona (Italy) is confirmed, together with the texts of its Proper of Masses and of the Liturgy of the Hours.
excerpt: Derthonensis, 3 ian. 1975 (Prot. n. 2434/74): confirmantur Calendarium et textus Proprii Missarum et Liturgiae Horarum.

summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary of Mercy is confirmed as principal patroness of the city of Ibarra (Ecuador).
excerpt: Ibarrensis, 28 ian. 1975 (Prot. n. 131/75): confirmatur electio Beatae Mariae Virginis de Mercede principalis apud Deum Patronae civitatis Ibarrensis.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Immaculata sub titulo « a sacro numismate »

excerpt: Tacuarembiana, 15 nov. 1974 (Prot. n. 2279/74): confirmatur electio Beatae Mariae Virginis Immaculatae sub titulo « a sacro numismate » principalis apud Deum Patronae dioecesis.

excerpt: Thessalonicensis, 25 martii 1975 (Prot. n. 261/75): confirmatur electio S. Pauli Apostoli principalis apud Deum Patroni Vicariatus Apostolici Thessalonicensis.

summary_en: The Missionaries of the Sacred Heart of Jesus may, for five years, celebrate their proper votive Mass of the Sacred Heart on the first Friday of every month, even when an obligatory memorial occurs, except in Lent.
excerpt: Missionarii Sacratissimi Cordis Iesu, 31 ian. 1975 (Prot. n. 182/75): conceditur ad quinquennium ut Missionarii Sacratissimi Cordis Iesu prima feria VI uniuscuiusque mensis celebrare valeant Missam votivam propriam de Sacratissimo Corde Iesu, etiam memoria obligatoria occurrente, excepto tempore Quadragesimae.

celebration.name_latin: D. N. Iesu Christi Summi atque Aeterni Sacerdotis

summary_en: The Misioneras de Jesús Sacerdote may celebrate each year, on the Thursday after Pentecost, in all houses of the congregation, the feast of Our Lord Jesus Christ the Supreme and Eternal Priest.
excerpt: « Misioneras de Jesús Sacerdote », 20 apr. 1975 (Prot. n. 324/75): conceditur facultas celebrandi quotannis feria quinta post Pentecosten, in omnibus domibus Congregationis, festum Domini Nostri Iesu Christi Summi atque Aeterni Sacerdotis.

summary_en: The second typical edition of the Roman Missal amends the Normae universales de anno liturgico et de Calendario, n. 59 (Table of Liturgical Days) item 11: the words "Provinciae, nationis, amplioris territorii, Ordinis seu Congregationis et" are omitted from a), b) is suppressed and c) becomes b); also editorial changes to nn. 14, 47 and 59, 12; recorded because it touches the precedence of patronal celebrations, with the Missal decree (Prot. N. 1970/74, 27 March 1975, p. 297) as its only protocol and date.
excerpt: n. 59, 11. a) Verba: « Provinciae, nationis, amplioris territorii, Ordinis seu Congregationis et » omittuntur. b) tollitur. c) fit b).

summary_en: In the second typical edition of the Roman Missal the titles of St Catherine of Siena (29 April) and St Teresa of Avila (15 October) become "virginis et Ecclesiae doctoris"; this change arrives inside the Missal edition (decree Prot. N. 1970/74 of 27 March 1975, p. 297) and not by a separate calendar decree.
excerpt: p. 544 « S. Catharinae Senensis, virginis et Ecclesiae doctoris ». Ita pro S. Teresia de Avila (p. 624).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Lugo (Spain) is confirmed; the protocol is printed without a year suffix (p. 341 prints it as Prot. CD 332/75 for the same diocese).
excerpt: Lucensis in Hispania, 20 oct. 1975 (Prot. CD 332).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the archdiocese of Lyon (France) is confirmed.
excerpt: Lugdunensis, 7 augusti 1975 (Prot. CD 36/75).

celebration.name_latin: B. Maria Virgo a La Salette

summary_en: In the parish church of St Francis of Assisi in the diocese of Pavia (Italy) the Mass of the Blessed Virgin Mary of La Salette may be celebrated each year on 19 September; a single-parish item.
excerpt: Papiensis, 13 sept. 1975 (Prot. CD 266/75): conceditur ut in ecclesia paroeciali S. Francisci Assisiensis die 19 mensis sept. quotannis celebrari possit Missa B. Mariae Virginis a La Salette.

summary_en: In the VII Pastoral Region of Peru the feast of the Exaltation of the Holy Cross may be celebrated on 3 May instead of 14 September, with the feast of the Apostles Philip and James transferred to 4 May.
excerpt: Peruviae dioeceses, 15 oct. 1975 (Prot. CD 230/75): conceditur ut in VII Regione Pastorali Peruviae festum exaltationis S. Crucis die 3 maii celebrari possit, loco diei 14 septembris, festo Apostolorum Philippi et Iacobi ad diem 4 maii translato.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the archdiocese of Reims (France) is confirmed.
excerpt: Remensis, 18 augusti 1975 (Prot. CD 97/75).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the dioceses of Sardinia (Italy) is confirmed.
excerpt: Sardiniae dioeceses, 20 sept. 1975 (Prot. CD 297/75).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the archdiocese of Siena (Italy) is confirmed.
excerpt: Senensis, 20 oct. 1975 (Prot. CD 523/75).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Troyes (France) is confirmed.
excerpt: Trecensis, 16 sept. 1975 (Prot. CD 82/75).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the whole Cassinese Benedictine Congregation and the proper calendars of its individual monasteries are confirmed.
excerpt: Congregatio Casinensis, O.S.B., 4 nov. 1975 (Prot. CD 474/75): confirmatur Calendarium proprium totius Congregationis necnon Calendaria propria singulorum Monasteriorum.

summary_en: It is established that the celebration of St Gemma Galgani is kept on 16 May by all who venerate her; the decree is listed under the Passionists but its wording ("ab omnibus qui eam colunt") reaches beyond the congregation.
excerpt: Congregatio Passionis Iesu Christi, 10 oct. 1975 (Prot. CD 204/75): statuitur ut celebratio S. Gemmae Galgani ab omnibus qui eam colunt, die 16 maii peragatur.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the Society of Mary is confirmed.
excerpt: Societas Mariae, 2 sept. 1975 (Prot. CD 194/75).

target.institute: Moniales S. Benedicti (Abbaye Saint-Louis du Temple, Limon, Igny)

summary_en: The proper calendar of the Benedictine nuns of the Abbaye Saint-Louis du Temple at Limon (Igny, France) is confirmed.
excerpt: Moniales S. Benedicti (Abbaye Saint-Louis du Temple, Limon, Igny), 18 augusti 1975 (Prot. CD 87/75).

summary_en: One-year ruling for 1975: since the Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed falls on Sunday 2 November 1975, the Congregation states that the evening Mass of 1 November is that of the solemnity of All Saints, the liturgical day of higher rank; communiqué published in L'Osservatore Romano of 29 October 1975, no protocol or decree date printed.
excerpt: Da varie parti si domanda quale Messa debba essere celebrata la sera del 1º novembre. ... Perciò in questo caso, la Messa celebrata il 1° novembre sera sarà della solennità di Tutti i Santi (cf. « Tabula dierum liturgicorum », 1, 3: « Missale Romanum », p. 110).

summary_en: List of the proper days of celebration of those beatified or canonized during the Holy Year 1975 - Beati: Maria Eugenia Milleret de Brou 10 March; Caesar de Bus 15 April; Carolus Steeb 15 December; Carolus Joseph Eugenius de Mazenod 21 May; Arnoldus Janssen 15 January; Ioseph Freinademetz 28 January; Maria Teresia Ledóchowska 6 July; Ezechiel Moreno Diaz 19 August; Gaspar Bertoni 12 June; Vincentius Grossi 7 November; Ioanna Francisca Michelotti 1 February; Maria Droste zu Vischering 8 June; Ioseph Moscati 12 April - Sancti: Ioannes Baptista a Conceptione 14 February; Vincentia Maria Lopez y Vicuña 26 December; Elisabeth Anna Bayley Seton 4 January; Ioannes Macias 16 September; Oliverius Plunkett 1 July; Iustinus de Jacobis 31 July; no protocol or date printed.
excerpt: De die proprio celebrationis Sanctorum vel Beatorum qui durante Anno Sancto 1975 Beatificati vel Canonizati sunt.
